*Swoosh*... With a flash of light, the Man of Steel was gone.
All that was left was the smoldering city, the mountain of corpses,
and the one who lost his love... Me.
She sacrificed herself so I would live. I was so pitiful.
What would happen to her? No, I knew exactly what would happen.
If that man didn't like her, he'd kill her. If he liked her, he'd make
her into an obedient doll, just like the others.
There was no way to save her... There was nothing I could do...
